control_detail.FlareZ: 116 disjoint 2,896-word literary windows (Latin Vulgate GP, Old English Beowulf GP, Gibran, Shakespeare, Emerson; raw and GP-converted) ALL detect the grammar, min z +2.8 (Beowulf), typically +6..+21; punctuation-role MI controls all z > +9.8.
control_detail.Fable52_t4: English windows (kjv/moby/pride/war, 8 windows each) min z +5.4; power on pride: 1.00 with all words in natural order, 0.40 with half, 0.15 with a quarter.

result: NO GRAMMAR. LP2 whole book MI z = +0.43 (FlareZ, p=0.30) / +0.51 (Fable52 t4, p=0.31); nine 875-word LP2 windows z in [-1.51, +2.30] against the solved-LP z = +7.43 at the same size. Sentence-role (length vs dot position) MI z = -1.37. A doubled-plaintext-rune insertion rule does not restore it (FlareZ, 15/15 controls keep z > +5). Independently found by FlareZ123 (2026-11-12), replicated by Fable52 with separate code.
coverage: Whole-book and 875-word-window adjacent word-length MI and sentence-role MI on the 2,896 printed words of LP2 p0-55 (p50 runeless), within-chapter shuffles. Detection power 1.00 when the printed order is the plaintext's natural order.
not_covered: Partial order preservation: power 0.40 at half the words in natural order, 0.15 at a quarter (Fable52 t4).

threshold: Exact key-independent invariant: for any deterministic per-phase map, same-phase equal-pair count M_cipher(q) >= M_plain(q). Exclusion iff M_original(q) < min over the 5 frozen donor windows at every q in range.
control_detail: FlareZ synthetic donor plants (incl. 29->15 many-to-one) satisfy the inequality at every tested period; nonaffine positive passes in their Windows CI. NOT re-run here. Original-side statistic reproduced locally from our canonical stream: M(840)=3277, M(3301)=634, identical to FlareZ (M0 verify_output.txt).
result: EXCLUDED for the stated register at every tested period: book-global q=1..3301 (3301/3301), nine-chapter resets q=1..1033, 13-dot-mark resets q=1..1033, physical-page resets q=1..130, printed-line resets q=1..22 (q>=23 NOT excluded: a donor ties/undercuts at q23). Smallest donor-minus-original gaps: 404 (global, q=3151), 101 (chapter), 84 (13-dot), 131 (page), 5 (line, q=22).
coverage: All deterministic per-phase maps 29->29 (permutation or not) at the listed periods and reset policies, over all 12,956 runes; native GP English represented by 5 donor windows (3 Crowley Book of the Law, 2 Blake Marriage of Heaven and Hell). This is a BOUNDED CLOSURE of the D-03 corner 'periodic/phase-indexed mono-rune maps' for that register; D-03 itself (stationary homophonic-downward class streams, other registers) stays as recorded in D-03 and R44-W2C9-D03-HOMOPHONIC-SCREEN.
not_covered: Randomised / homophonic EMISSION (one plaintext rune -> several ciphertext runes): the inequality does not bind; this is D-03's core and stays open beyond R44-W2C9's detection-conditioned screen.

hypothesis: LP2 is a previous-ciphertext-keyed secret substitution C_i = S[table, C_(i-1)](P_i) with fully secret rows: one 29x29 table per illuminated chapter (+ up to 3 extra page rekeys), or a GP28 no-repeat variant with one 29x28 table per chapter and resets at every printed word (and optionally page).
threshold: Exact row-majorization (all-key) invariant: the k most frequent plaintext symbols cannot exceed the sum of the k largest outgoing transition counts per row; exclusion iff the bound falls below the minimum native-control occupancy for some k.
control_detail: FlareZ: synthetic encoders with genuinely random row permutations (and the 63 repeat exceptions via sidecar) decrypt 12,956/12,956 and satisfy every majorization inequality. Not re-run here.

(b) GP28 row-permutation, chapter tables, word resets, all 63 within-word repeats + word starts free: 256/256 plants per donor violate, min violation +71, EO- and OE-excluded alphabets, with or without page resets.
coverage: Global/per-chapter previous-ciphertext-keyed secret substitution (full 29-way and GP28 derangement), all secret row permutations, native GP English (Gibran, Shakespeare, Emerson; ING/IO spelling variants) at every 12,956-rune window. hypothesis: LP2 is a deterministic stationary plaintext-history cipher C_i = F(P_(i-m..i)) with ONE book-global table (arbitrary, including nonlinear 29^(m+1) tables and the four-sum state model), memory m = 4..7, preserving printed word boundaries.
threshold: Exact all-key suffix implication: two complete words sharing their final m+n plaintext runes must share their final n ciphertext runes. Original has 0 equal last-4 pairs among words >= 8 runes and 4 equal last-3 pairs among words >= 7; exclusion iff native controls need more.
control_detail: FlareZ: full 29x29 native forward plants satisfy both inequalities and reproduce their ciphertext exactly. Not re-run here. Original-side facts reproduced locally: 2,896 words, 0 last-4 pairs (words>=8), 4 last-3 pairs (words>=7) (M0 verify_output.txt).
result: EXCLUDED for memory 4, 5, 6, 7 with a single global table: 384/384 original-word-length native control manuscripts (128 each Shakespeare/Gibran/Emerson) violate, for every possible table. At memory 8 some Emerson controls pass: do not extrapolate. Memories 1-3 are bounded by a companion FlareZ study (plainprev short-memory two-output suffix gate) that M0 did NOT read or import.
coverage: Key-independent bound on the PLAINTEXT-source, global-table corner of R12-C1 (whose own sweep covered k=2..6 over 23,520 natural f and only 29 all-equal pt seeds) for m=4..7; also covers fully nonlinear history tables R12-C1 never represented.

control_detail: No heterogeneity plant was run by FlareZ for these nulls. result: T7 SURVIVES every coarse conditioning: chapter counts fixed p=0.00005 (0/20,000); page p=0.0046; page x 13-dot p=0.0022; 4 word/line classes p=0.0004; page x word/line p=0.0058; page x 13-dot x word/line x exact word length (1,508 strata) p=0.0077; whole page-tape permutation within chapters p=0.00014. Page-half counts p=0.038. Only the SATURATED nulls go quiet: printed-line counts (594 strata for 86 events) p=0.232 and event-bearing-word identity p=0.259 - both condition on nearly the observed positions. T7 stays LIVE. The '1,649-rune span' is three consecutive gaps 400/712/537 with two internal doublets (first-rune 0-based sites 2739/3139/3851/4388); longest single gap 712 (p=0.52 under uniform, Fable52); max 3-gap sum p=0.035 flat / 0.505 page-conditioned.
